one_liner: Coda has a free, broad REST API (v1) with personal API tokens, and an official hosted MCP server at coda.io/apis/mcp.
auth_notes: The REST API is documented around personal API tokens. OAuth2 with PKCE is documented only for the MCP, and only with an mcp:all scope. So API_KEY is primary for the REST API.
access_notes: The API is stated to be free in free and paid workspaces, and tokens are generated in account settings. The truncated page text shows a "Free and Paid Workspaces" section but not its body, so the free-of-charge claim is only partly verified here.
blocker_notes: None found. The Admin API is Enterprise-only, but the main v1 API is not.

evidence.quote: We make the Coda API available to all of our users free of charge, in both free and paid workspaces.
you can generate an API token at [https://coda.io/account](https://coda.io/account)
The primary way to connect is via OAuth2 with PKCE, a three-legged authorization flow.
then click **Generate API token**). Give your token a memorable name, ensure that the restriction type is **MCP**, and choose the type of access.
